semantics: Static final-footprint bound (no timing; identical across starts). Per Leo (ENVELOPE_BURNSET_RULE.md, 2026-11-12): the burn set is the final mapped burn set of the whole event on the shared 79x237 375 m export grid (finite kriged TOA, FIRMS and AHI buffers): 16,176 of 18,723 cells, about 2,275 km2, burning on [0, H) with births 0. NO_ROUTE here means no route avoiding that whole footprint from t = 0. It is not the pessimistic edge of a leave-by band, and it says nothing outside the mapped burn set. Report it as its own row. Composition (Leo, from variants/envelope_sound_counts.json): burn set = kriged footprint (finite TOA, 10,955 cells, about 1,540 km2) + buffered firing-AHI pixels only (4,940 cells, about 695 km2, 31 %) + FIRMS-detected cells outside both (281). It is broader than the mapped perimeter, so "sound relative to the final mapped burn set" means relative to this union, not the perimeter alone.
